items.title: Alibaba & Macy's Rise, Snap Shares Tumble | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Shares of Alibaba (BABA) rise after disclosing a deal to sell its gaming arm and touting claims of more than 3 billion downloads for its open AI model. - Shares of DR Horton (DHI) and Macy's (M) are moved higher after Berkshire Hathaway disclosed stakes in the companies in a filing. - Shares of Snap (SNAP) are down in trading Monday. The stock is set to end its win streak over past two sessions.
